1.text: Zaburi iyi yahimbiwe umutware w'abaririmbyi. Ni iyo mu buryo bwa Yedutuni. Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi.

2.text: Umutima wanjye uturize Imana yonyine,Ni yo agakiza kanjye gaturukaho.

3.text: Ni yo gitare cyanjye yonyine n'agakiza kanjye,Ni igihome kirekire kinkingira sinzanyeganyezwa cyane.

4.text: Muzageza he gutera umuntu ngo mumwicane mwese,Nk'inkike ibogamye, nk'uruzitiro runyeganyega?

5.text: Iki cyonyine ni cyo bajya inama,Ni ukugira ngo bamusunike ngo agwe,Ave mu cyubahiro cye.Bishimira ibinyoma,Basabirisha umugisha akanwa kabo,Ariko bavumisha imitima yabo.Sela.

6.text: Mutima wanjye turiza Imana yonyine,Kuko ari yo ibyiringiro byanjye biturukaho.

7.text: Ni yo gitare cyanjye yonyine n'agakiza kanjye,Ni igihome kirekire kinkingira sinzanyeganyezwa.

8.text: Imana ni yo irimo agakiza kanjye n'icyubahiro cyanjye,Igitare cy'imbaraga zanjye n'ubuhungiro bwanjye biri mu Mana.

9.text: Mwa bantu mwe, mujye muyiringira,Ibyo mu mitima yanyu mubisuke imbere yayo,Imana ni yo buhungiro bwacu.Sela.

10.text: Ni ukuri aboroheje ni umwuka gusa,Kandi abakomeye ni ibinyoma.Nibashyirwa mu gipimo ntibazika bazateruka,Bose bateranye umwuka ubarusha kuremera.

11.text: Ntimwiringire agahato,Ntimwizigirire ubusa kunyaga,Ubutunzi nibugwira ntibuzabaherane imitima.

12.text: Imana yavuze rimwe, nabyumvise kabiri,Ngo “Imana ni yo ifite ububasha.”

13.text: Kandi ni wowe Mwami ufite imbabazi,Kuko witura umuntu wese ibikwiriye umurimo we.
